description: Kenichi,Hattori starts attending school undercover,occasionally accompanied by his brother,Shinzo,Shishimaru the ninja dog and Kenichi's girlfriend, Yumeko. The gang is also threatened by the rival Koga ninja and his evil Shadow-cat.

Kenichi expresses his admiration
videos.overview: Inspired by his father's busy life, Kenichi and his family decide to build a hot spring at home. Will their shared dream become a reality?

videos.title: Kenichi feels overjoyed
videos.overview: Yumeko's compliment on Kenichi's lunchbox fuels his desire to impress her further. Can he win her over with a drawing of her?

videos.title: Kanzou Hattori to help Kenichi
videos.overview: Kenichi struggles with setbacks, leaving him disheartened. Kanzou Hattori steps in, crafting a plan to lift his spirits. Will it work?

videos.title: Kenichi becomes anxious
videos.overview: Kenichi's messy room becomes a crisis when Yumeko visits. Desperate, he turns to Kanzou Hattori for help. Will his friend lend a hand?

videos.title: Kanzou Hattori motivates Kenichi
videos.overview: Kenichi fears the spinning ring contest. Kanzou encourages him to practice and win. Will Kenichi rise to the challenge?

videos.title: Kentaro is confused
videos.overview: Kentaro's India business trip is turning into a logistical nightmare. His family's overpacked luggage threatens to derail his journey. What will he do?

videos.title: Kanzou Hattori receives a job offer
videos.overview: Kanzou Hattori lands his dream job: entertaining kids as a cartoon character at the mall. Can he bring joy and laughter to his young audience?

videos.title: Kenichi enjoys his time
videos.overview: Left alone at home while his family shops, Kenichi is terrified by news reports of two dangerous robbers. Can he protect himself?

videos.title: Kagechiyo grows worried
videos.overview: Kagechiyo and Shishimaru clash in a battle of strength. But Kagechiyo's victory is short-lived when his tail gets trapped, putting him in a desperate situation.

videos.title: Kenichi to fulfil his mother's wish
videos.overview: Driven by love for his mother, Kenichi and his brothers embark on a perilous quest to find legendary mushrooms atop a treacherous mountain.

videos.title: Kenichi helps his grandmother
videos.overview: Kenichi and his brother help Grandma clean, then try to impress their parents by cleaning their own house. Will they succeed?

videos.title: Shinzo feels upset
videos.overview: Kenichi's illness brings his mother's attention, leaving Shinzo feeling neglected. What will he do to win her affection?

videos.title: Amara vows to defeat Kanzou Hattori
videos.overview: Armed with a high-tech helmet, Amara sets his sights on conquering Kanzou Hattori. Can his newfound powers lead him to victory?

videos.title: Kagechiyo executes his plan
videos.overview: Shishimaru's family eats all the food, leaving him hungry. Kagechiyo sees an opportunity to sow discord between Shishimaru and Kenichi's family. Will his plan succeed?

videos.title: Kanzou Hattori uses his skills
videos.overview: Kenichi's family worries as their leaky roof drips relentlessly. Kanzou Hattori, with his peculiar skill, gathers the falling water. How long can he hold this task?

videos.title: Kanzou Hattori gets interrogated
videos.overview: Kanzou Hattori, a ninja, is suspected by the police of being the Ninja Thief. Taeko steps in to clear his name. Will she succeed?

videos.title: Kentaro's busy schedule
videos.overview: Kentaro chooses to finish his office work at home, making it clear to his family not to disturb him during his work. Will he manage to complete his work without any interruptions?

videos.title: Kanzou Hattori offers his help
videos.overview: Kanzou Hattori, a teacher, takes charge during a supervised walk. Chaos erupts when a child chases a cat. Can he restore order?

videos.title: Kanzou Hattori instructs Kenichi
videos.overview: Kenichi seeks meditation guidance from Kanzou Hattori, who sets rigorous training. Will Kenichi persevere and master the art?

videos.title: Kanzou Hattori gets scared
videos.overview: Kagechiyo's pup-like disguise tricks Shishimaru into attacking Kanzou. A frog-fueled fright ensues. Can Kanzou unravel the mystery behind the attack?

videos.title: The Tripod Competition
videos.overview: In order to prove his friends wrong, Kenichi persuades Hattori to pose as his father for the upcoming school's Tripod Competition. Will Hattori help him?

videos.title: The lottery ticket
videos.overview: Kentaro's lottery win brings joy, but fear for his family's safety leads him to demand secrecy. Will they keep his secret?

videos.title: The new smartphone
videos.overview: Kentaro's new smartphone mesmerizes his family, leading them into a world of digital dependence. Can Hattori guide them back to reality?

videos.title: The Ninja Princess
videos.overview: Kenichi's mockery of Yumeko's "Ninja Princess" story sparks a challenge. Teaming up with Kemumaki, she awaits his surprise at her favorite spot.

videos.title: The missing ninja sword
videos.overview: Hattori helps Taeko eradicate the pest problem at home. However, he misplaces his ninja sword while helping Kenichi's family. Can they help him find his sword?

videos.title: The drawing classes
videos.overview: Yumeko is offended by Kenichi's poor drawing of her. Can he redeem himself by taking drawing classes from Hattori and impressing her?

videos.title: The house shifting
videos.overview: Koike-Sensei's plan to impress Aiko-Sensei with his help during the shifting process is sabotaged by Hattori. Can he fix it?

videos.title: The ninja mother
videos.overview: Kenichi discovers his mother, Taeko, secretly dressed as a ninja. With Hattori's help, they uncover the truth behind her mysterious activities.

videos.title: Shinzo learns ninja techniques
videos.overview: Shinzo is impressed by Hattori's ninja skills in the kitchen. Hattori offers to train Shinzo, but will he master the ninja techniques?

videos.title: Funny pet video
videos.overview: Yumeko shares funny pet videos with Kenichi. Inspired, Kenichi films his dog, Shishimaru, hoping to impress her. Will his attempt be a success?

videos.title: The fast-forwarding ninja technique
videos.overview: Upon Kenichi's request, Shinzo unravels a secret fast-forwarding ninja technique. However, the boon turns into a curse making Kenichi very slow. Can Hattori reverse the curse?

videos.title: Kemaki injures his leg
videos.overview: Kemaki gets hurt while practising his ninja skills. However, he continues to play the victim at school to enjoy the attention and benefits. Will he get caught?

videos.title: A secret autograph
videos.overview: Kenichi treasures a prized autograph, keeping it hidden from loved ones. Will his secret be revealed?

videos.title: The bunny technique
videos.overview: Kemaki mocks Kenichi when the latter fails miserably at sports. However, Hattori offers to help Kenichi excel at sports and teaches him a bunny ninja technique. Will he succeed?

videos.title: Kagechiyo's new pet
videos.overview: While honing his ninja skills, Kagechiyo finds a helpless cat. He secretly takes it in, but will his kindness be exposed by Kemaki?

videos.title: Hattori keeps his promise
videos.overview: Hattori refuses to reveal Yumeko's secret when Kenichi blackmails him. Meanwhile, Kemaki disguises himself as Yumeko to find out the secret. Will Hattori fall for his trap?

videos.title: The ninja dog
videos.overview: Shishimaru's ninja training takes a turn when he meets a skilled ninja dog. Will the dog's lessons help him master the art?

videos.title: Kenichi is in trouble
videos.overview: Kemaki frames Kenichi for messing with the cement during their schoolyard paving project. Can Kenichi clear his name?

videos.title: The ninja fireworks
videos.overview: Kenichi's date is ruined, but Hattori's ninja fireworks promise a spectacular alternative. Kemaki, learning the truth, plots sabotage. Will his scheme succeed?

videos.title: The truth serum
videos.overview: Shinzo, questioning Hattori's aloofness, concocts a truth serum. But her experiment backfires, revealing her family's secrets. Will she face the consequences?

videos.title: The chaotic guest
videos.overview: Ninja Hattori's family is gone, leaving him alone with a neighbor's pet frog. Will he handle the amphibian duties?

videos.title: Practice makes you perfect
videos.overview: Ninja Hattori trains Shinzo and Shishimaru, but their concentration falters. Can they master ninja skills with his help?

videos.title: The unclever Shinzo
videos.overview: Ninja Hattori and Shishimaru teach Shinzo the hearing technique. As Shinzo strives to improve, Kiyo overhears and tells Amara. Will this revelation lead to new challenges

videos.title: My dream sweet dream
videos.overview: Scared by a scary show, Kenichi can't sleep. Ninja Hattori uses a dream technique to help him overcome his fear, giving him a special moment with Umiko. Will it work?

videos.title: Amara's ride to flying cot
videos.overview: Amara shows Umiko a flying machine picture, promising a ride. Kenichi joins them. Will Amara have a surprise plan during their flight?

videos.title: Shinzo's special Ninja technique
videos.overview: Shinzo seeks a Ninja technique to control tears, reading emotional tales. His own tears cause chaos, disrupting others. Can he master the technique without causing disturbance?

videos.title: The machine doll
videos.overview: Kenichi builds a machine for Umiko, but Amara's interruption threatens to derail his efforts. Will Umiko's dream be fulfilled?

videos.title: Ours home is ours
videos.overview: As Kenichi's rundown house gets renovated, they reside at his father's friend's place. They are surprised by the new facility. Will the unexpected upgrade bring happiness?

videos.title: Mom's heart fills with joy
videos.overview: Inspired by a neighbor's garden, Kenichi's mom dreams of homegrown meals. Ninja Hattori helps her grow the perfect ingredients for a culinary masterpiece!

videos.title: Kenichi is at tight situation
videos.overview: Defeated in sumo by Amara, Kenichi seeks help from Ninja Hattori. Can Hattori's training give Kenichi the edge for the rematch?

videos.title: Amara creates trouble to Shinzo
videos.overview: Shinzo works hard to buy his favourite toy, but Amara exploits his innocence, causing trouble. Will Shinzo overcome this setback and still manage to get his cherished toy?

videos.title: Ninja Hattori's weak memory
videos.overview: Kenichi's memory loss from a small accident worries his family. Without his Ninja skills, will Kenichi regain his memories and abilities, or face new challenges in his journey?

videos.title: Collecting Chestnuts
videos.overview: Hattori and friends are collecting chestnuts, but Amara is humiliating Kenichi in front of Yumiko. Will Hattori teach Amara a lesson?

videos.title: Hattori becomes a trainer, again
videos.overview: An actor wants to become a ninja, and therefore comes to Hattori for training. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and see if he successfully completes the training.

videos.title: Save Ms. Aiko
videos.overview: Kenichi overhears Ms. Aiko talking about someone troubling her every night. Can he and Hattori help Ms. Aiko and catch the troublemaker?

videos.title: Too many cooks spoil the broth
videos.overview: Hattori's childhood friends are visiting and have to uncover scrolls hidden at different locations. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and see if they're successful in their mission.

videos.title: Smoke Signal Ninja Technique
videos.overview: Hattori trains Shinzo in a new ninja technique, but Amara's interference disrupts their progress. Can Hattori decipher Amara's mischief?

videos.title: A day without ninja techniques
videos.overview: Shinzo forbids Hattori from using any ninja technique for a day. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and see if hattori can survive without it.

videos.title: Return of favors
videos.overview: Mummy helps Keo with carrying some boxes, and now, he wants to return the favor by helping her in completing household chores. Will he do the work without her noticing?

videos.title: Ninja Gum Ball
videos.overview: Hattori introduces Shinzo to ninja gum, however he keeps it hidden from him. Shinzo finds the gum and uses it, but lands into a problem. What will he do now?

videos.title: Female Koga Ninja in town
videos.overview: A female Koga ninja is in town to defeat Hattori. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and see if she is successful in finishing her mission.

videos.title: Kite fight competition
videos.overview: Kenichi and Amara are participating in a kite fight competition. But, Amara is back at playing tricks to win. Who do you think will emerge victorious?

videos.title: An underground hotel?
videos.overview: Kenichi and the ninjas build an underground hotel using their skills. But Amara is out to stop them. Will they succeed?

videos.title: Bamboo Ninja Technique Challenge
videos.overview: Amara challenges Hattori to a race using bamboo ninja technique. As always, Amara plans to cheat. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and find out who wins the race.

videos.title: Bamboo Ninja Technique Challenge
videos.overview: Amara builds a ninja drone to trouble Hattori, however he is unable to stick the GPS chip onto Hattori. Will Amara's hardwork go to waste?

videos.title: Jobs for the three
videos.overview: Hattori's childhood friends are back and are working at a store. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and find out if their work is going on smoothly or not.

videos.title: Kenichi becomes a Salesman
videos.overview: Kenichi and the ninjas are helping a distressed salesman. Soon, Amara reaches to make things worse. How will they tackle him and his tricks?

videos.title: Fighter Shinzo
videos.overview: Shinzo has beaten Hattori in a ninja technique and feels he has completed his training. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and find out if Shinzo's attitude results in his downfall.

videos.title: Ninja Traffic Safety class
videos.overview: Kenichi's road safety lesson for kindergarteners is disrupted by Shinzo and Shishimaru's bickering. Ninja Hattori reveals the root of their conflict.

videos.title: Exchanged love letters
videos.overview: Mr. Koike is writing letters to his mother and Ms. Aiko simultaneously, and while posting the letters get interchanged. How will he get out of this mess?

videos.title: Shinzo's new friends
videos.overview: Shinzo's ninja skills are fun... until they make his friends mad. Can he win them back? Watch Ninja Hattori!

videos.title: Ninja Flute Player
videos.overview: A ninja is playing flute & hypnotising dogs. Hattori and Shinzo decide to reach to the issue's core. Will they find out who is behind all this?

videos.title: Shishimanu's Training
videos.overview: Shishimanu is going away from home to become a ninja. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and find out if he completes the training.

videos.title: A picture with Celebrity
videos.overview: Kenichi bluffs, in school, of having a picture with a celebrity. He later takes Hattori's help to prove it to his friends. Will Hattori be successful in completing this task?

videos.title: I don't want to be class monitor!
videos.overview: Kenichi and Amara are contesting for becoming the next class monitor. Suprisingly, none of them want to become the monitor. Tune in to Ninja Hattori to find out why.

videos.title: Say no to Ninja Techniques!
videos.overview: The ninjas have sweared to not use ninja tool for the day. When Amara learns about this, he starts to trouble them. What does Hattori have in store for him?

videos.title: Cup & Ball Tournament
videos.overview: A cup and ball tournament are about to happen in school. Kenichi challenges Amara for the same. Who do you think will win?

videos.title: Shinzo, a billionaire?!
videos.overview: Shinzo is helping anyone who's facing a problem and in return recieves gifts as a gesture. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and find out if he becomes a billionaire.

videos.title: Ninja Snowball Fight
videos.overview: Kenichi and the ninjas indulge in a ninja snowball fight. With Amara's team having lesser member, who do you think will win?

videos.title: Skiing trip
videos.overview: Kenichi and friends are out on a skiing trip, and the former boasts of being a champion. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and see if Kenichi can uphold the title.

videos.title: Amara's Challenge to Hattori
videos.overview: Amara orders Keo to send out a challenge to Hattori, but, he's unable to locate Hattori. How will Keo find Hattori?

videos.title: Shinzo's heavyweight training
videos.overview: Shinzo wears the heavyweight suit without telling Hattori. However, he is now on his way to market. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and see if he can make it there.

videos.title: Beach Café
videos.overview: Daddy's friends beach café isn't doing well, therefore, the Mitsuba family helps him and advertises the café. Do you think that customers will visit the beach café?

videos.title: Hattori's thunderous sneezes
videos.overview: Hattori is unwell and his stormy sneezes have created problems, and in addition Shinzo's ninja technique has made things worse. What's in store for Hattori?

videos.title: Cleaning spree
videos.overview: Mummy has appointed Kenichi to clean the entire house before she returns from the market. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and see if he can do this task without the ninjas.

videos.title: Guest's incoming
videos.overview: Mitsuba family is about to leave for a day out, when Mr. Mitsuba's friend drops at their home unexpectedly and doesn't leave. How will the kids get rid of the guest?

videos.title: Amara's road to fitness
videos.overview: Amara has suddenly gained a lot of weight and Keo is worried about his health. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and find out what Hattori has in store for Amara.

videos.title: A day out with a celebrity
videos.overview: Hattori and friends spend a day with a celebrity and take her to places she has never been to. But, there's more to this. Stay tuned to find out.

videos.title: Be Careful!
videos.overview: Hattori is training Shinzo and Shishimanu to save them from fraudulent people. However, Hattori falls for a trap himself. What will he do now?

videos.title: Koike Sirs' Marriage Proposal
videos.overview: Koike sir is meeting random women, making Ms. Aiko believe that he's dating them. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and find out if this is true or not.

videos.title: Hattori is misunderstood
videos.overview: The ninjas, Kenichi & Yumiko misunderstand Hattori's actions on Keo. Will they come to know the reason behind his action?

videos.title: A vacation to Hawaii!
videos.overview: Kenichi boasts of going to Hawaii in front of their friends, however it gets cancelled. Let's watch Ninja Hattori and see what he does now.

videos.title: A visit by Indian Ninja
videos.overview: A tech-savvy Indian ninja is here to fight Hattori, to become world's number 1 ninja. However, rains play a spoilsport. Who do you think will win?

videos.title: Shishimanu leaves home
videos.overview: Shishimanu is tired of being scolded by Hattori and therefore, decides to leave the house and train on mountains. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and see if he sticks to the plan.

videos.title: Keo in danger
videos.overview: Keo goes to a stranger's house as he's tired of Amara. But, his new owner has trapped him in a cage. How will Keo escape from his new house?

videos.title: Mummy's daughter?
videos.overview: Isaiyo returns to face Hattori, but finds unexpected help on her journey. Mummy takes her in, leaving Kenichi and the ninjas surprised.

videos.title: A cup worth million
videos.overview: Hattori helps an old man and as a thank you gift, recieves a bowl, which goes on to Shishimanu. However, he's unaware of its value. Will they learn the value of the bowl?

videos.title: Shinzo's own room
videos.overview: Shinzo wants his own room to play and read comics, as Kenichi scolds him. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and find out if he gets his own room.

videos.title: Tyumeko's Piano Performance
videos.overview: Shinzo wants his own room to play and read comics, as Kenichi scolds him. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and find out if he gets his own room.

videos.title: Detective Mummy
videos.overview: Kenichi imitates a TV actor to solve small cases at home. However, Mummy is always steps ahead of him. Tune in to Ninja Hattori and see if Kenichi can supercede Mummy.

videos.title: Don't Be Scared!
videos.overview: Amara mocks Kenichi of being timid, and calls him to watch a horror film at his place with Yumiko and the ninjas. Can Hattori make him bold? Stay tuned and find out for yourself.

videos.title: A flying squirrel Ninja
videos.overview: Shishimanu feels worthless when his friend Momonbe's work is praised by Mummy. Can Momonbe help him regain his confidence?

videos.title: Invisible Ink's Good luck charm
videos.overview: Kenichi uses invisible ink as good luck charm, in order to patch up with Yumiko. However, the trick misfires. Tune in to Ninja Hattori to find out what he'll do now.

videos.title: Goodbye, Kenichi
videos.overview: Hattori's parents are here to take him and his brother back to Ega village. Kenichi overhears and is upset. Will Hattori leave him forever?
